description: Search, read and act on Apple Mail — threads, attachments, body search, writes off by default
name: io.github.mgcrea/mcp-apple-mail

environmentVariables.description: Register the mutating tools. Off by default, and the gate decides whether the write tools exist at all rather than merely refusing — an agent with writes off cannot see them.
environmentVariables.name: APPLE_MAIL_ALLOW_WRITES

environmentVariables.description: Restrict every read and write to these Mail accounts, by name. Bounds reading, not just writing.
environmentVariables.name: APPLE_MAIL_ACCOUNTS

title: Apple Mail
